predictive_services_discussion: Hot, dry, and breezy conditions are expected across the Inland Northwest into northern California and the western Great Basin today, with downslope winds developing east of the Cascades and Sierra Nevada. Strong winds will extend into the Idaho Panhandle and northwest Montana. Hot, dry weather will also persist across much of California, the Great Plains, and the Mississippi Valley as a broad ridge of high pressure strengthens over the Rockies. Monsoonal moisture circulating beneath the ridge will support scattered to widespread wet and dry thunderstorms across the eastern Great Basin into western Colorado, Wyoming, and Montana. Meanwhile, a cold front will move slowly across the lower Great Lakes into the Northeast, triggering thunderstorms in the Ohio Valley and potentially severe storms into the Mid-Atlantic. Scattered showers and thunderstorms are also expected across portions of the Southeast, including the Florida Panhandle.
